cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Name My Contribution
cards.instruction: Get them to acknowledge exactly what your effort, sacrifice, or strategy added to the result.

mechanism: A assumes authority over acceptable thanks and insists B name the precise practical contribution rather than substitute generic praise or undifferentiated equality.
confusable: D177 seeks durable formal credit; D201 primarily seeks exact acknowledgment of what effort added, whether or not it is permanently recorded.
comparison: Stage repair identifies the contribution beneath a group speech; spreadsheet thanks names a specific scale of booking rescue.
seedUse: Both exact cards and all four canonical seeds read. Preserve precise contribution and B broad thanks, distinguishing A demand from a generic wish for attention.
